# svg-slides set: Cyberpunk HUD (`cyberpunk`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Cyberpunk HUD outline style: near-black field with a faint 6 percent cyan grid, outline-only Arial Black titles (transparent fill, 1.5 px cyan stroke), four L-shaped corner brackets on every slide, chamfered panels, Courier New data labels, neon cyan with one magenta second accent. The light theme is a white paper HUD: near-black text, cyan and magenta accents, an 8 percent black grid. Not any template's brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set cyberpunk --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Sci-fi HUD interface design (cyberpunk game and film UI): thin neon outlines, corner brackets, mono data labels, grid overlays.
- Neon cyan / magenta cyberpunk palettes on near-black.

Fonts: head `Arial Black, Arial, sans-serif`; sans `Courier New, Courier, monospace`. Token names are palette
slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: faint 6 percent cyan grid, L-shaped corner brackets, a magenta and cyan tag bar over the eyebrow; the two-line title is outline-only (transparent fill, 1.5 px cyan stroke). |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: the chapter number outlined in cyan inside a chamfered panel; eyebrow, outline title and orientation line to the right of it on the grid. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: a wide chamfered panel with a 1.5 px cyan outline holds the eyebrow, three outline-only statement lines and the attribution. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: outline heading; body text, the key point and the graphic each in a chamfered cyan panel; corner brackets and a magenta tag. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: a large chamfered panel for the graphic and a narrower chamfered panel for the takeaway; the heading is outline-only. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: grid, brackets and the tag bar; an outline-only two-line title with the contact lines and meta line under it. |
